entities.name: Uracil phosphoribosyltransferase
observations: The 215-aa query sequence is an exact full-length match to reviewed UniProt B1VF60, annotated as uracil phosphoribosyltransferase (EC 2.4.2.9).
Reviewed homologs A4QC29 and P58998 annotate the same activity; their sequences are 80.7% identical over near-full length.
Reference annotation reports one Mg2+ per subunit, bound as Mg-PRPP.

entities.name: Uracil + PRPP to UMP
observations: RHEA:13017 reaction: uracil + 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate (PRPP) ⇌ UMP + diphosphate; UniProt EC 2.4.2.9 annotation.
